 def object_detector(image_path, labels, threshold, model_size, padding):
    from object_detector_tool import *
    detection = tool.execute(image=image_path, labels=labels, threshold=threshold, model_size=model_size, padding=padding)

def count_big_nuts(bowl):
    from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
    # Load the dataset and vectorize the texts using TF-IDF
    vocabulary = set(bowl)
    tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(vocabulary=vocabulary).fit_transform(bowl)
    # Transform the feature matrix to a bag-of-words representation
    tfidf_vector = tfidf.toarray()
    # Find the most frequent words
    frequent_words = np.argsort(tfidf_vector.sum(axis=1).flatten().cumsum())[-5:]
    return frequent_words
